timing: Written after the first screening analysis showed that within-facet mean signed errors were approximately zero by identification/alignment construction.
problem: Averaging aligned errors over all levels of a sum-to-zero facet, or over centered thresholds, mechanically cancels positive and negative level errors. Numerical intervals around values of order 1e-17 are constraint/rounding artifacts rather than useful bias signals.

remediation.main_effect_bias: For every estimator, distribution, design, facet, and named level, report the 20-replicate mean signed error, sample SD, Monte Carlo SE, and screening interval.
remediation.threshold_bias: For every estimator, distribution, design, criterion, and category threshold, report the corresponding 20-replicate quantities.
remediation.paired_shape: Compute level-specific non-normal minus normal error contrasts within replicate.
remediation.paired_design: Compute level-specific planned-connected minus complete error contrasts within replicate.
remediation.facet_summary: Summarize the vector of level mean errors by RMS level bias and maximum absolute level bias; do not average signed errors to zero.
remediation.output: Write a new screening_analysis_v2 directory and retain the first analysis unchanged as diagnostic evidence.

interpretation: Intervals remain unadjusted 20-replicate screening diagnostics. Individual interval exclusions are not confirmatory; magnitude, cross-replicate stability, neighboring-element structure, and consistency across estimands are required before selecting a future contrast.
unchanged: No generated row, estimate, fit status, denominator, original paired RMSE/MAE output, or operational gate is changed.
